milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate to and visually observe the cut sandstone slabs placed at (~3.5, ~0, ~-2.5) in the northeast area of the temple. position_near_with_facing is preferred over position_inside_box for find tasks because it models 'player can see the target' by checking both proximity and facing direction. max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to clearly see the half-height slabs, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking toward the slab cluster rather than just passing through the area.

Uses inventory_has because mining sandstone_stairs with any pickaxe drops the block itself as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with a wooden pickaxe (sufficient for stone-tier blocks like sandstone variants, confirmed via wiki). Since sandstone_stairs is not in the starting inventory, having min_count=1 in inventory is definitive proof the player successfully mined at least one sandstone_stairs block. inventory_has is preferred over mine_block event counters because it directly checks the tangible outcome.
